title: AI Isn't Replacing SREs. It's Deskilling Them
script:
SigNoz warns that generative AI is quietly deskilling site reliability engineers.
Automated models now generate runbooks, write code snippets, and draft routine post-mortems.
Instead of manual triage, teams rely entirely on automated assistants for quick fixes.
This shortcut prevents junior engineers from building deep foundational debugging habits.
When complex production outages hit, teams struggle without deep systems knowledge.
Would you rely entirely on automated code fixes?
